description: This file implements a handler class for processing streaming responses from various language model endpoints, including chunk processing, logging, and model-specific handling. It manages response chunks, injects cost information, routes logs to specific handlers based on endpoint type, and supports asynchronous operations.

classes.name: PassThroughStreamingHandler
classes.description: A handler class providing static methods for processing streaming responses from different LLM endpoints, managing chunk streaming, logging, and model-specific operations.

methods.description: Processes response chunks asynchronously, collects raw bytes, injects cost if needed, and triggers post-processing logging after completion.

methods.name: _route_streaming_logging_to_handler( litellm_logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, passthrough_success_handler_obj: PassThroughEndpointLogging, url_route: str, request_body: dict, endpoint_type: EndpointType, start_time: datetime, raw_bytes: List[bytes], end_time: datetime, model: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Routes collected response chunks to specific logging handlers based on endpoint type (Anthropic, Vertex, OpenAI). Sends logs asynchronously and submits sync callbacks if applicable.

methods.description: Determines the model name for cost calculation either from request body, logging context, or URL (for Vertex AI).

methods.name: List[str] _convert_raw_bytes_to_str_lines(raw_bytes: List[bytes])
methods.description: Converts accumulated raw bytes into a list of string lines, similar to the behavior of aiter_lines in async streams.
